image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers discussing a technical diagram on a central whiteboard. One points at the diagram; the other has an open questioning palm. Draw one very simple complete diagram: three empty rectangular boxes connected by arrows, with a second small branching path to suggest two possible routes. The full diagram sits inside the central whiteboard, clear and easy to crop. No labels, code, jargon, numbers, or decorative math. Minimal clean office.
